findings.text: follow-on: the exchange is exercised only against an in-memory FakeGraph whose _Transaction.run reimplements every SOURCE_EXCHANGE statement in Python (tests/standard_names/test_signed_source_exchange.py:32), so the real closure, refusal, mutation and postcondition Cypher has no test that reddens if it regresses; the only check on those statements is the EXPLAIN parse gate, and two mutation-statement defects found during development (an invalid infix NOT IN, commit 7459ff1; a missing participant recheck, commit af537ca1) were caught by EXPLAIN and review rather than by any test.

follow-on: SOURCE_EXCHANGE_MUTATION (imas_codex/standard_names/signed_manifest.py:7275) writes PRODUCED_NAME, the source scalar mirror and status but does not maintain the touched names' source_paths projection nor the DD-side HAS_STANDARD_NAME edge that the sibling ordinary-source migration writer maintains (signed_manifest.py:4546), so after a live apply readers of those projections see the pre-swap ownership until a reconcile pass runs (imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:1493).

follow-on: the new adapter has no production call site — no CLI command and no graph_ops partial passes authority_adapter="dd-source-exchange" (the literal occurs nowhere outside signed_manifest.py), so the separately dispatched apply node must add the caller that this writer is built for before the swap can run.

follow-on: the brief named sib-apply-live-rulings.html and its JSON as authority to read (both refusal receipts and the missing-owner statement); the fragment records them absent at inspection (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-signed-source-exchange.html:68) and they remain absent from both the base and the main checkout, the apply run r-20261019T185427204526 still being in flight, so the preview's admission decision rests on the fresh live closure rather than on the prior receipts the brief required.

justifications.durability: test_failed_name_postcondition_rolls_back_every_write fails when the name postcondition is removed (negative-control.log, EXIT=1), but the tests drive a Python stand-in for the Cypher at tests/standard_names/test_signed_source_exchange.py:32 so the shipped statements have no regression-failing test.
justifications.evidence: the gate's own logs are recorded and complete — baseline-suite.log and head-suite.log each end on a passed totals line and EXIT=0 — and the negative-control log shows a real red at EXIT=1 whose failing id the head arm passes.
justifications.fit: the adapter follows the newest sibling idiom — _load/_closure/_refusal/_preview/_apply mirroring _load_recovery_unbind_rows at signed_manifest.py:6467, reusing _TransactionQuery, _digest and require_producing_sources, with SourceExchangeConflict subclassing SignedManifestConflict at :320.
justifications.goal_fidelity: signed_manifest.py:7167 builds the one-transaction exchange with the four required refusals at :7059 and the three postconditions at :7167, and live-preview.json shows the intended separatrix swap previewing as would_apply with zero refusals.
justifications.reuse: the capability owner was searched by mechanism: retarget_standard_name_sources (provenance_lifecycle.py:505) moves a bound source to another name and the ordinary-source migration (signed_manifest.py:4546) moves a fixed source's holder, neither of which binds an unheld source to a fixed name, so the new adapter extends the shared envelope rather than forking an existing owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 5220d41e..fff443986 touches only signed_manifest.py, test_signed_source_exchange.py and the fragment, all three inside the declared write paths, with no goal-external change.

notes: Independent review of the landed node. Head gate recorded at 322a28752, which is the last code commit; the final commit fff443986 changes the fragment only. The single named test file was re-run at head inside the source worktree and passed 16 cases (review-test-run.log, EXIT=0).

verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 5220d41e to fff443986; seven commits touch only the declared three paths (+997/-5), the final commit fff443986 being fragment prose only so the head gate at 322a28752 covers every line; the diff adds the exchange adapter and its tests and nothing else.
verdicts.done_when: the done_when is no added failures on the signed-manifest gate; baseline-suite.log shows 254 passed/0 failed and head-suite.log shows 270 passed/0 failed, both EXIT=0, so added_failure_count is 0.
verdicts.goal: the node goal is a signed program that exchanges a live name's DD producing source in one transaction; imas_codex/standard_names/signed_manifest.py:7167 _apply_source_exchange implements it, and the read-only preview in live-preview.json returned outcome=would_apply, would_change=1, 0 refusals against DD 4.1.1.
verdicts.manifest: read at .../manifest.md; it states 254→270 passed with zero added failures, the negative-control log at EXIT=1, and the live preview receipt, all of which the run's own logs confirm.
verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are signed_manifest.py, tests/standard_names/test_signed_source_exchange.py and the sib-signed-source-exchange.html fragment; every path in the diff 5220d41e..fff443986 is one of the three.
